EXIT_OBSERVER: independent actual waits/lifetime identity and remaining-member evidence;bootstrap result insufficient
KERNEL_BOUNDARY_REQUIREMENT: If independent runtime/launch exclusion cannot establish complete process graph,an independently enforceable inherited kernel boundary is required. No particular cgroupv2 capability or future TasksMax result inferred.
LAUNCH_INTERCEPTION: must cover birth before workload runs and all permitted native/startup/transitive creation. Existing parent Popen->register sequence can lose evidence ifparent fails before registration.
PROCESS_MEMBERSHIP: complete independently enforced inherited boundary OR independently qualified spawn-exclusion/runtime closure plus sole external birth/exit ownership
PROCESS_REGISTRY: PID+birth token+session/boundary+fixed launch ordinal for workload parent and helpers;known registry alone insufficient
SUPERVISOR_OWNER: independent qualified resource/observer principal;actual executable/permission unsealed
TERMINATION_MECHANISM: independent kill/reap of every relevant member;separate sessions explicitly covered;unknown surviving descendants prevent success
